✨ obs-web | Svelte
🎯 Primary Use Case: Remotely controlling OBS Studio from a web browser on any device.
✨ Key Features: • Browser-based control (desktop + mobile) • Support for local network and internet control (WSS tunnels) • Switch scenes, start/stop streaming and recording • Studio Mode support • Virtual Camera support
📖 Summary: OBS-web is a browser-based application that allows users to remotely control OBS Studio, offering features like scene switching, stream/recording control, and live preview. It requires OBS version 28+ and the obs-websocket plugin, and can be accessed locally or over the internet via WSS tunnels.
